icicles: Gentoo's make-obsolete WHEN patch (icicles-fn.el fails to load on 29+ without it); hexrgb added as a dependency, icicles-cmd1.el calls it at top level
regress: (eval-when-compile (require 'cl)) from Gentoo: the loop macro was used without it
rnc-mode: flymake-proc-* names (Gentoo); the flymake integration errored on the pre-26 names
teco: Gentoo's three patches in Gentoo's order: display-table for ESC in the command minibuffer, interactive-p/last-command-char, old backquotes
dropdown-list: selection face inherits dropdown-list-face, not the group (Gentoo)
erobot: interactive spec no longer starts with two ignored arguments (Gentoo)
wikipedia-mode: requires outline-magic, which it calls (Gentoo); dependency added
deferred: deferred:process-shell passes one command string to start-process-shell-command (Debian); exercised: (deferred:process-shell "echo" "hello" "world") returns "hello world"
bongo: mpv's --input-ipc-server=FILE as one argument (Debian); exercised: bongo-compose-remote-option gives ("--input-ipc-server=/tmp/sock")
atomic-chrome: save binding C-c C-s, upstream commit ae2a6158 via Debian; exercised: C-c C-s is atomic-chrome-send-buffer-text
ledger-mode: git master 2026-07-27 rather than 4.0.0: the release's define-obsolete-function-alias lacks WHEN and does not load on Emacs 29+; ledger-test.el is a real module and is kept
rpm-spec-mode: Thaodan's fork at the commit Fedora ships (2024-12-09): the 2016 original's define-obsolete-variable-alias calls lack WHEN
emhacks: recentf.el, ruler-mode.el and tree-widget.el (2007 copies of what Emacs ships, which would shadow it from site-lisp) and jsee.el (needs JDE) are removed
planner: planner-gnats.el (needs a gnats.el nobody has) and planner-ledger.el (the pre-ledger-mode ledger.el) removed
cider: the test-file removal is turned off: cider-test.el is the test-runner integration
emacs-aio: aio-contrib.el needs elfeed and stays source
dired-hacks: dired-images.el looks for ImageMagick's mogrify at load and stays source
julia-repl: upstream marks it no-byte-compile; installed as source
zenburn-theme: NonGNU ELPA; the theme file is no-byte-compile
bind-chord: only bind-chord.el from the use-package tarball (use-package is in Emacs 29)
nerd-icons: data/*.el compiled and installed under data/, where nerd-icons-data requires them
emojify: data/ (emoji tables) installed; emojify-set-emoji-data loads 5489 emoji
treemacs: icons/ and src/scripts/ installed under the package directory, where treemacs-dir points
systemd-mode: the *-directives.txt tables installed; 305 unit directives load
geiser-guile: src/ (the scheme side) installed next to the lisp
hexrgb: dev.gentoo.org copy; upstream (emacswiki) is not a fetchable site
org-mode: GNU ELPA org 9.8.10; shadows the org bundled with Emacs 30 (9.7), which is the point
transient: GNU ELPA 0.13.8, newer than the 0.7 bundled with Emacs 30; magit needs it
editorconfig-emacs: the same 0.11.0 Emacs 30 bundles; kept for emacs29
yatex: 1.84 from yatex.org. Two fixes: yatexlib's XEmacs colour probe tested device-class, which Emacs 30 now has (frame.el) without selected-device, so the library died without a display; yahtml-define-instag-key passed a void env and a fourth argument its callee did not take (both as in upstream git 2026). yatex19.el/yatex23.el refuse batch compilation and stay source. Exercised: yatex-mode and yahtml-mode set up in a buffer
navi2ch: SourceForge; the *.el compile without its configure
mu-cite: jpl.org snapshot 2020-11-03 (Gentoo's 8.1_p...); needs apel, flim, bbdb
scala-mode: scala-tool-support 2.10.7 from scala-lang.org, the scala-emacs-mode/ subtree
vhdl-mode: 3.39.3 from ETH; its site-start.el (an installation hook) is not installed, it would shadow the real one
cycle-buffer: the copy Gentoo's ebuild points at (github.com/gavv/distfiles); upstream is gone
autoconf-mode: autoconf-mode.el and autotest-mode.el from the autoconf 2.72 tarball (devel/autoconf does not install them)
sumibi: 0.7.4 from OSDN, client/elisp; the server side is a separate program
emacs-wget: upstream (infoseek) is gone; Gentoo's distfiles mirror; lpath.el (a build helper) not installed
mldonkey: upstream (fu-berlin.de) is gone; Gentoo's distfiles mirror and its two patches (the second fixes a lambda list with two &optional, which the byte-compiler rejects)
